form_title: Application for Grant of Licence to Import Medical Device

guidance.what_it_is: Formal statutory application letter addressed to the Drugs Controller General (India).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Establishes applicant intent, lists applied device models, accessories, intended use, and summarizes statutory fee payments.
guidance.official_citation: Medical Devices Rules, 2017, Rule 34(1)
guidance.who_issues: Indian Authorized Agent on official corporate letterhead
mandatory_inclusions: Device brand names and generic names
Risk classification (Class A, B, C, or D)
Foreign manufacturing site physical address
BharatKosh treasury transaction ID and payment date
critical_pitfalls: Discrepancies between letterhead entity name and Form 20B/21B wholesale licence.
Missing authorized signatory stamp or signature.

guidance.what_it_is: Official treasury payment receipt generated from the BharatKosh portal (Non-Tax Receipt Portal).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Mandatory proof of statutory fee deposit into the Consolidated Fund of India for import licence evaluation.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Second Schedule, Rule 34(1)
guidance.who_issues: Government of India BharatKosh Portal (bharatkosh.gov.in)
guidance.validity_period: Current (transaction reference valid for applied filing)
mandatory_inclusions: BharatKosh Transaction Reference Number
Correct CDSCO Drawing & Disbursing Officer (DDO) code
Head of Account 0210 - Medical and Public Health
Exact statutory fee matching device count and manufacturing site tier
critical_pitfalls: Payment mapped to incorrect DDO account or state treasury.
Underpayment due to uncalculated distinct manufacturing sites or device models.

guidance.what_it_is: Prescribed statutory pro-forma Form MD-14 for import licence application under Medical Devices Rules, 2017.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Legal instrument formally requesting grant of licence in Form MD-15 from the Central Licensing Authority.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017, Rule 34(1), Form MD-14
guidance.who_issues: Authorized Indian Agent representing the overseas manufacturer
mandatory_inclusions: Full corporate legal name and address of overseas manufacturer
Actual manufacturing site address where manufacturing occurs
Complete device nomenclature, model codes, and intended usage
Authorized Agent constitution and wholesale drug licence details
critical_pitfalls: Mismatch between device trade names on Form MD-14 and overseas Free Sale Certificate.
Missing digital or physical statutory signature of authorized agent.

slots.title: Power of Attorney along with undertaking per Fourth Schedule Part I

guidance.what_it_is: Legal instrument authorizing Indian Agent to act on behalf of the foreign manufacturer, executed on non-judicial stamp paper.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Statutory prerequisite conferring legal standing under Indian law to submit dossiers, report vigilances, and market devices.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part I, Clause 1
guidance.who_issues: Foreign Manufacturer (Executive Director / Managing Director)
guidance.validity_period: Valid for stated tenure (typically 5 years) or until revoked in writing
mandatory_inclusions: Apostille certificate (Hague Convention) or Indian Embassy / Consular legalization
Specific enumeration of applied device models and variants
Mandatory Fourth Schedule Part I undertaking clauses verbatim
Notarization in country of origin
critical_pitfalls: Unapostilled or unnotarized power of attorney from overseas jurisdiction.
Omission of mandatory statutory undertaking clauses from Fourth Schedule Part I.

slots.title: Copy of Whole Sale Licence / Manufacturing Licence / Form MD-42

guidance.what_it_is: Certified copy of valid wholesale drug licence (Form 20B / Form 21B) or Medical Device Registration Certificate (Form MD-42).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Proves the authorized agent is licensed under Drugs & Cosmetics Act to stock, sell, and distribute medical devices in India.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(2)
guidance.who_issues: State Drugs Control Administration (SLA) of respective Indian State / UT
guidance.validity_period: Must remain unexpired during entire evaluation and licensing period
mandatory_inclusions: Active validity date with retention fee receipt if applicable
Competent technical personnel / registered pharmacist endorsement
Physical warehouse address matching Indian Agent address
critical_pitfalls: Submitting expired licence without proof of retention fee payment.
Address mismatch between wholesale licence and corporate profile.

slots.title: Constitution Details of the Authorized Agent

guidance.what_it_is: Legal constitutional documents establishing the corporate identity and authorized signatories of the Indian entity.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Verifies that the entity and signatories have legal authority to enter binding regulatory agreements in India.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(2)
guidance.who_issues: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (ROC) / Registrar of Firms
guidance.validity_period: Perpetual (reflecting latest active directorship and shareholding)
mandatory_inclusions: Certificate of Incorporation (CIN / LLPIN)
Memorandum & Articles of Association (MoA & AoA) or Partnership Deed
Current List of Directors with DIN numbers
Board Resolution authorizing designated signatory
critical_pitfalls: Board resolution signed by unauthorized person or missing official corporate seal.
Outdated director list conflicting with Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal.

slots.title: Free Sale Certificate from Country of Origin

guidance.what_it_is: Free Sale Certificate (FSC) or Certificate to Foreign Government (CFG) issued by National Regulatory Authority of country of origin.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Certifies that the device is freely marketed and distributed in the domestic market of the overseas manufacturer without restrictions.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(3)
guidance.who_issues: National Regulatory Authority / Ministry of Health of Country of Origin
guidance.validity_period: Valid as indicated on certificate, or within 2 years from date of issuance
mandatory_inclusions: Exact commercial device names and catalogue / model numbers
Explicit confirmation that devices are approved for domestic sale
Legal manufacturer and manufacturing site name and address
Duly notarized and apostilled / legalized
critical_pitfalls: Certificate states 'For Export Only' (immediate CDSCO rejection).
Omission of catalogue numbers or variant codes applied in India.

slots.title: Free Sale Certificate from Reference Countries (USA, UK, EU, Canada, Japan, Australia)

guidance.what_it_is: Marketing authorization or Certificate to Foreign Government from one or more GHTF/IMDRF recognized reference jurisdictions.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Statutory benchmark establishing proven international safety record; prerequisite for clinical evaluation waivers in India.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(3)
guidance.who_issues: US FDA, UK MHRA, EU Competent Authority, Health Canada, Japan PMDA/MHLW, or TGA Australia
mandatory_inclusions: US FDA 510(k) Premarket Notification / PMA / CFG, or EU CE Certificate under MDR 2017/745, or TGA ARTG Entry
Model listing covering applied SKUs
Notarized certificate copy
critical_pitfalls: Reference approval under transition period without valid MDR extension documentation.
Applied device variant not covered in the reference approval scope.

guidance.what_it_is: Official registration certificate or licence proving the foreign manufacturing facility is legally registered in its host jurisdiction.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Confirms the manufacturing premises are authorized by host government authorities to engage in device manufacturing.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(3)
guidance.who_issues: Host Country Regulatory Department / Municipal Health Bureau
mandatory_inclusions: Facility Establishment Identifier (FEI) / Registration Number
Exact physical manufacturing site location
Approved manufacturing activities (assembly, packaging, sterilization)
critical_pitfalls: Address discrepancy between establishment licence and ISO 13485 QMS certificate.

slots.title: Latest Inspection or Audit Report within last 3 years

guidance.what_it_is: Regulatory audit report or inspection outcome conducted by a competent regulatory authority or MDSAP auditing organization.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Evaluates ongoing GMP compliance, systemic corrective actions, and historical audit findings for the manufacturing facility.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(3)
guidance.who_issues: Competent National Authority / Notified Body / MDSAP Auditing Organization
guidance.validity_period: Conducted within preceding 36 months of submission
mandatory_inclusions: Date and scope of facility inspection
Summary of inspection findings or Form FDA 483 with closeout letter
Formal closeout of observed major non-conformities
critical_pitfalls: Submitting an audit report older than 3 years.
Submitting open warning letters without formal regulatory clearance proof.

guidance.what_it_is: Accredited ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System Certificate for the foreign manufacturing facility.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Statutory proof under MDR 2017 that medical devices are produced under validated, international quality control standards.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(4) & Fifth Schedule
guidance.who_issues: IAF-accredited Certification Body or Notified Body
mandatory_inclusions: Explicit scope covering design, manufacture, and packaging of applied device category
Exact manufacturing site physical address matching application
Accreditation mark (e.g. UKAS, DakkS, ANAB) and certificate number
Duly notarized copy
critical_pitfalls: Applied device type missing from scope of certification.
Certificate expiring within less than 60 days of submission.

slots.title: Full Quality Assurance Certificate / CE Certificate

guidance.what_it_is: European CE Certificate under EU MDR 2017/745 or MDD 93/42/EEC (with valid extension confirmation) issued by a designated Notified Body.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates independent third-party assessment of design dossier and production quality system.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34(4)
guidance.who_issues: Designated European Notified Body (e.g. BSI, TÜV SÜD, DNV, DEKRA)
guidance.validity_period: Current validity period or official Regulation (EU) 2023/607 transition confirmation
mandatory_inclusions: Notified Body 4-digit identification number
Annex IX (Quality Management) or Annex X (Type Examination) certification
Product catalogue codes and classifications
critical_pitfalls: Submitting expired MDD certificate without manufacturer declaration of EU transition compliance.
Mismatch in Notified Body identification.

guidance.what_it_is: Solemn legal declaration issued under sole responsibility of the manufacturer affirming conformity to applicable regulatory standards.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Legally binds manufacturer to declarations of compliance with essential safety, performance, and harmonized international standards.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part I, Clause 2
guidance.who_issues: Legal Manufacturer (Head of Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs)
mandatory_inclusions: Full device trade names, risk classification, and product codes
List of harmonized standards applied (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601)
Statement of sole manufacturer legal responsibility
Signature and title of responsible regulatory officer
critical_pitfalls: Missing reference to Indian Medical Devices Rules, 2017.
Omission of applied device model numbers.

slots.title: Plant Master File (Appendix I of Fourth Schedule)

guidance.what_it_is: Comprehensive technical dossier detailing manufacturing premises, environmental controls, equipment, and quality operations.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Enables statutory evaluation of cleanrooms, contamination controls, water systems, and GMP readiness of overseas facility.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part II (Appendix I)
guidance.who_issues: Foreign Manufacturer Operations & Quality Engineering Teams
guidance.validity_period: Current (updated on major facility change or annually)
mandatory_inclusions: General information and corporate organogram
Scaled cleanroom layout plans (ISO Class 7/8) with air pressure cascades
HVAC and water system validation summaries
Equipment calibration master list and validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ)
critical_pitfalls: Unscaled architectural layouts or missing cleanroom classifications.
Exceeding the 10MB portal size ceiling without pikepdf downsampling.

guidance.what_it_is: Concise overview summarizing technical dossier, regulatory history, commercial background, and risk profile.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Primary evaluation briefing document reviewed by CDSCO technical officers and Subject Expert Committees (SEC).
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 1.0
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Regulatory Affairs Team
mandatory_inclusions: Intended clinical purpose and indications for use
Global marketing history across reference countries
Adverse event summary and recall history
Statutory risk-benefit conclusion
critical_pitfalls: Contradiction between intended use in Executive Summary and approved IFU.

guidance.what_it_is: Detailed scientific narrative describing operating principles, raw materials, physical dimensions, and engineering schematics.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Provides technical understanding of how the device functions and interacts with biological systems.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 2.0
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer R&D and Product Engineering
mandatory_inclusions: Device operational mechanisms and diagrams
Comprehensive Bill of Materials (BOM) including patient-contacting polymers/metals
Novel technology disclosures (if applicable)
critical_pitfalls: Generic descriptions omitting chemical grades of patient-contacting materials.

guidance.what_it_is: Scientific rationale explaining why applied models are grouped under a single application per CDSCO grouping guidelines.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Validates grouping category (Single, Family, System, IVD Test Kit, or Group) to prevent improper fee minimization.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34 & CDSCO Grouping Guidelines
guidance.who_issues: Regulatory Specialist / Manufacturer
mandatory_inclusions: Grouping category applied (Single, Family, System, Kit)
Demonstration of identical intended use, design technology, and manufacturing process
Tabular model comparison across dimensional variations
critical_pitfalls: Grouping devices with different intended uses or distinct manufacturing sites under a single Family.

slots.title: Product Specification, including variants, accessories, etc.

guidance.what_it_is: Comprehensive technical specification sheet enumerating all catalogue numbers, sizes, configurations, and compatible accessories.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Defines the exact legal scope of devices authorized for commercial import into India.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 4.0
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Product Quality Engineering
mandatory_inclusions: Table listing Catalogue Number, Variant Name, Dimensions, Shelf-Life
Identification of included accessories and spare components
Physical, electrical, and chemical performance limits
critical_pitfalls: Omitting catalogue numbers from technical specification table that appear on commercial packaging.

guidance.what_it_is: Side-by-side comparative table demonstrating substantial equivalence between applied device and a legally marketed predicate device.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Substantiates safety and performance equivalency, supporting waiver of local clinical trials in India.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 5.0
guidance.who_issues: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
mandatory_inclusions: Predicate brand name, manufacturer, and CDSCO import licence / US FDA 510(k) number
Side-by-side comparison of intended use, materials, performance, and technology
Detailed scientific justification of any dimensional or material differences
critical_pitfalls: Selecting an unapproved device in India as predicate without clinical trial data.
Superficial comparison table ignoring technological differences.

slots.title: Labelling Information (Labels, Instruction for Use, etc.)
slots.statutory_rule: Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.0 & Chapter VI

guidance.what_it_is: Complete artwork files for primary packaging labels, outer carton labels, blister packs, and Instructions for Use (IFU).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Enforces compliance with statutory Indian labelling rules under Chapter VI of MDR 2017.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Chapter VI, Rules 44–58 & Fourth Schedule
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Packaging Design Team
mandatory_inclusions: Prominent 'FOR IMPORT' statement or Indian Import Licence placeholder (Licence No. MD-15-XXXX)
Indian Authorized Agent legal name and physical address
Standardized ISO 15223-1 symbols (Sterile, Lot, Expiry Date, Single Use)
Storage temperature specifications and warning precautions
critical_pitfalls: Missing MRP sticker space or Indian Agent details on outer carton artwork.
Discrepancies in shelf-life between label and stability study data.

guidance.what_it_is: Detailed engineering schematics, manufacturing flowcharts, critical in-process control points, and subcontracted process details.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates process capability and reproducibility across all stages from raw material to finished packaged device.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 7.0
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Process Engineering Team
mandatory_inclusions: Sequential manufacturing process flowchart
In-process quality control (IPQC) inspection gates and acceptance criteria
Details of critical subcontractors (e.g. outsourced contract sterilizer)
critical_pitfalls: Failure to disclose offsite contract sterilization facilities.

slots.title: Essential Principles Checklist for Demonstrating Conformity to Safety and Performance

guidance.what_it_is: Statutory matrix evaluating device conformity against all General and Specific Essential Principles of Safety and Performance.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Core regulatory spine demonstrating conformance to statutory safety principles per Fourth Schedule Appendix II.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Appendix II
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Regulatory Compliance Engineering
mandatory_inclusions: Applicability determination across all statutory clauses (Clauses 1 to 15)
Specific harmonized international standard cited for each clause
Precise cross-reference to supporting laboratory test report in dossier
Clear scientific justification for any non-applicable clauses
critical_pitfalls: Marking clauses as 'Not Applicable' without valid scientific rationale.
Missing cross-references to test report numbers in validation annexures.

guidance.what_it_is: Risk management summary report conducted in strict adherence with ISO 14971:2019.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates all foreseeable hazards have been identified, mitigated, and residual risks are outweighed by clinical benefits.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.1 & ISO 14971
guidance.who_issues: Risk Management Lead & Product Safety Committee
mandatory_inclusions: Risk management plan and comprehensive Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)
Pre-mitigation and post-mitigation risk severity/probability matrices
Risk-benefit analysis conclusion signed by qualified authority
critical_pitfalls: Submitting an outdated risk assessment omitting post-marketing complaint data.
Unmitigated risks remaining in unacceptable hazard regions.

slots.title: Verification and Validation of the Medical Device

guidance.what_it_is: Master verification and validation summary covering bench mechanical testing, electrical safety, EMC, and environmental durability.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Primary engineering proof confirming physical device conforms to design specifications under stress conditions.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.2
guidance.who_issues: Accredited Laboratory (NABL / GLP / ILAC) or Manufacturer Test Lab
mandatory_inclusions: Test protocols, acceptance criteria, raw data curves, and final results
IEC 60601-1 (Electrical Safety) and IEC 60601-1-2 (EMC) test reports (if active/powered)
Mechanical fatigue, burst strength, and tensile test records
critical_pitfalls: Submitting summaries without complete underlying test laboratory reports.
Tests performed on non-sterilized or non-production-equivalent prototypes.

guidance.what_it_is: Biological evaluation report documenting cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation, and systemic toxicity per ISO 10993 series.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates device patient-contact safety without toxic leaching or biological incompatibility.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.2 & ISO 10993-1
guidance.who_issues: GLP-accredited testing laboratory or certified toxicologist
guidance.validity_period: Perpetual unless material formulation or manufacturing process changes
mandatory_inclusions: GLP compliance statement from accredited testing laboratory
Sample preparation extraction conditions (polar and non-polar solvents)
Endpoints evaluated matching device contact category and duration per ISO 10993-1
critical_pitfalls: Submitting testing on raw resin pellets rather than finished, sterilized devices.
Testing conducted by non-GLP accredited facility.

slots.title: Medicinal Substances Data (if device contains Drug)

guidance.what_it_is: Scientific dossier on ancillary medicinal substance incorporated in the medical device (e.g. drug-eluting stent, antimicrobial catheter).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Allows statutory consultation between Medical Device division and Central Drug Standard Control Organization pharmaceutical reviewers.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.3
guidance.who_issues: Drug Manufacturer / Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) Supplier
mandatory_inclusions: Proof of qualitative and quantitative API composition
Drug elution kinetic profile and in vitro release curves
Compatibility and stability of drug in combined matrix
critical_pitfalls: Missing Drug Master File (DMF) accession letter from API manufacturer.

guidance.what_it_is: Risk assessment and viral/prion inactivation validation for devices containing materials of animal or human origin (ISO 22442).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Ensures elimination of Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (TSE/BSE) risks in biological tissues.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.4 & ISO 22442
guidance.who_issues: Tissue Source Supplier / Qualified Virologist / Manufacturer
mandatory_inclusions: Source animal origin, geographic sourcing, and veterinary health certs
Viral clearance and prion inactivation validation studies
Alternatively, Non-Animal Origin Declaration if synthetic
critical_pitfalls: Sourcing tissues from countries not classified as negligible BSE risk.

guidance.what_it_is: Sterilization validation study report establishing Sterility Assurance Level (SAL 10^-6) in accordance with ISO 11135 or ISO 11137.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Mandatory proof that sterile devices are free from viable microorganisms and ethylene oxide (EO) residual limits comply with ISO 10993-7.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.5
guidance.who_issues: Sterilization Facility / Accredited Microbiology Laboratory
guidance.validity_period: Annual re-validation audit or upon sterilization cycle alteration
mandatory_inclusions: Sterilization method (EO, Gamma Irradiation, E-Beam, Moist Heat)
Bioburden testing and fractional cycle sublethal lethality runs
Sterile barrier packaging validation per ISO 11607-1/2 (dye penetration, burst, peel)
Ethylene oxide and ethylene chlorohydrin residual test data (for EO sterilization)
critical_pitfalls: Packaging integrity test omitted after simulated shipping transit.
EO residuals exceeding statutory limits permitted by ISO 10993-7.

guidance.what_it_is: Software lifecycle documentation, architecture diagrams, cybersecurity risk assessment, and verification reports per IEC 62304.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Ensures Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and embedded firmware function reliably without algorithmic flaws or cyber vulnerabilities.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.6 & IEC 62304
guidance.who_issues: Software Engineering & Cybersecurity Verification Teams
guidance.validity_period: Current major software version / build release
mandatory_inclusions: Software Safety Classification (Class A, B, or C) per IEC 62304
Software Architecture & Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
Cybersecurity threat modeling and vulnerability patch protocol
Traceability matrix linking software requirements to test cases
critical_pitfalls: Missing software version release history or unexplained unresolved anomalies.

guidance.what_it_is: In vivo pre-clinical animal study reports evaluating functional tissue remodeling, implant placement, and physiological compatibility.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Substantiates safety and preliminary performance in living models prior to human clinical exposure.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.7
guidance.who_issues: GLP Pre-clinical CRO / Institutional Animal Ethics Committee (IAEC)
mandatory_inclusions: Animal ethics committee approval documentation
Study protocol, animal model rationale, and histology / pathology slides
Statistical evaluation of in vivo performance
critical_pitfalls: Animal studies performed in non-GLP accredited facilities without ethics committee approval.

guidance.what_it_is: Real-time and accelerated stability study reports validating physical, chemical, and packaging integrity over the claimed shelf-life.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Statutory basis supporting the expiration date printed on commercial device labels.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.8 & ASTM F1980
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Quality Control Laboratory
guidance.validity_period: Full claimed shelf-life duration (e.g. 3 years or 5 years)
mandatory_inclusions: Arrhenius equation acceleration factors and temperature/humidity conditions (e.g. 55°C / 75% RH)
Testing across minimum 3 distinct production lots
Package seal strength and sterile barrier testing at all time intervals
critical_pitfalls: Claiming a 5-year shelf life based solely on ongoing accelerated testing without interim data.
Testing on non-production-standard packaging.

slots.title: Clinical Evidence / Clinical Evaluation Report (CER)
slots.statutory_rule: Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.9 & Chapter VII

guidance.what_it_is: Comprehensive Clinical Evaluation Report (CER) synthesizing clinical investigation data and peer-reviewed scientific literature.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates clinical safety, clinical performance, and acceptable risk-benefit profile in the target patient population.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Chapter VII & Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.9
guidance.who_issues: Certified Clinical Regulatory Evaluator / Medical Director
guidance.validity_period: Updated annually (Class C/D) or biennially (Class A/B)
mandatory_inclusions: Systematic literature review search protocol, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and appraisal
Analysis of clinical investigations conducted worldwide
Clinical evaluator curriculum vitae and signed declaration of objectivity
critical_pitfalls: Submitting superficial literature reviews that omit known adverse complications.
Evaluating off-label clinical uses not matching the statutory IFU.

guidance.what_it_is: Periodic Safety Update Report (PSUR) and global post-marketing vigilance log summarizing complaints, recalls, and Field Safety Notices.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates that active surveillance is maintained and device malfunction rates in the field remain within acceptable risk bounds.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.10 & Rule 88
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Post-Market Vigilance Team
guidance.validity_period: Cumulative data covering preceding 3 to 5 years
mandatory_inclusions: Global distribution sales volume vs total reported adverse events ratio
Summary of Field Safety Corrective Actions (FSCAs) and recalls
Trend analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) implemented
critical_pitfalls: Concealing foreign market recalls or regulatory warning notices.
Missing adverse event complaint rate calculations.

slots.title: Batch Release Certificates or Certificate of Analysis for 3 Consecutive Batches

guidance.what_it_is: Finished product Certificates of Analysis (CoAs) from 3 consecutive commercial manufacturing batches (or Software Version Release Certificate).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Demonstrates manufacturing consistency, parameter control, and release testing conformance across production lots.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III Clause 6.11
guidance.who_issues: Manufacturer Quality Assurance & Release Chemist
mandatory_inclusions: Batch numbers, manufacturing dates, and expiration dates
All finished device release testing parameters and quantitative results
Quality Assurance Manager approval signature and date
critical_pitfalls: Submitting CoAs from non-consecutive or laboratory experimental batches.
Results reported as 'Complies' without quantitative test values.

guidance.what_it_is: Supplementary documents, non-commercial undertakings, distributor authorizations, or regulatory clarification letters.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Allows applicant to address specific statutory queries, previous rejection observations, or ancillary certifications.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Discretionary
guidance.who_issues: Applicant / Foreign Manufacturer
mandatory_inclusions: Clear explanatory note stating the purpose of each attached exhibit
critical_pitfalls: Uploading unorganized or redundant files that do not directly pertain to statutory requirements.

slots.title: Copy of Permission in Form MD-27 (in case of Investigational Medical Device)

guidance.what_it_is: Official approval permission in Form MD-27 issued by the Central Licensing Authority for investigational medical devices.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Statutory prerequisite for devices without predicate or approved clinical history in India requiring local clinical trial clearance.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 34 & Rule 59 (Form MD-27)
guidance.who_issues: Drugs Controller General (India), CDSCO HQ New Delhi
guidance.validity_period: Valid as specified on Form MD-27
mandatory_inclusions: Official Form MD-27 permission certificate number and date
Subject Expert Committee (SEC) recommendation endorsement
Approved clinical trial protocol identification
critical_pitfalls: Applying for commercial import licence without prior Form MD-27 clearance for novel investigational devices.
